title: 野生眉怎么选：五官、骨相与个人风格
title_en: Choosing hair-stroke brows: facial features, bone structure and personal style
intro: 项目是完成设计的工具。先把五官与骨相、原生眉和个人风格看清楚，再讨论采用哪一种做法。
intro_en: A service is a way to carry out a design. Consider facial features and bone structure, existing brows and personal style before choosing the method.

sections.title: 框架比较完整
sections.description: 讨论眉头、眉峰、眉尾和轮廓是否需要调整，是否只需少量补充毛流。手工或单仪器都有可能成为讨论方向，不凭照片直接下结论。
sections.description_en: Discuss whether the start, arch, tail or outline needs refining, and how much hair-like detail is needed. Manual or single-instrument approaches may be considered, but a photograph alone is not enough to decide.

sections.title: 结构与层次需要一起考虑
sections.title_en: Structure and layers both need attention
sections.description: 在适合采用主线条与绒毛线组合的设计中，主线条先建立主要结构与毛流方向，突出眉部与眉眶骨之间的视觉立体关系；绒毛线再丰富疏密、深浅与虚实，让线条自然衔接。目标是有框架、有层次、有自然毛流，并与五官协调，不是把所有空隙填满或单纯加深。
sections.description_en: Where a combination of main and fine strokes is appropriate, main strokes establish structure and hair direction, bringing out the visual relationship between brows and brow bone. Fine strokes then vary density, tone and definition to connect the lines naturally. The aim is a framework with layers and natural hair flow that complements the features, not filling every gap or simply adding darkness.

sections.title: 审美偏温柔自然，设计不受风格限制
sections.title_en: A preference for softness, with room for every individual style
sections.description: 乐乐老师个人偏爱温柔、自然、原生态，审美带有东方美学的柔和与含蓄，但私人定制不局限于一种眉形。温柔自然、清冷精致或利落英气，都可以结合五官、骨相、个人气质与审美需求设计。到店设计免费，约30–45分钟，确认适合再决定。
sections.description_en: Lele personally favours soft, natural brows and the restraint of Eastern aesthetics, but bespoke design is not limited to one style. Soft and natural, cool and refined, or clean and strongly defined brows can be tailored to the person’s features, bone structure, character and preferences. The design consultation is free and takes about 30–45 minutes; see the proposal before deciding.
